title: Design, synthesis, biological evaluation and structure-activity relationship study of quinazolin-4(3H)-one derivatives as novel USP7 inhibitors.
authors: Li, Peng; Liu, Ying; Yang, Hua; Liu, Hong-Min
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP7小分子抑制剂的设计合成与活性评价，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且方法以湿实验为主，仅含简单对接，与本课题无关。
abstract: Recent research has indicated that the abnormal expression of the deubiquitinase USP7 induces tumorigenesis via multiple cell pathways, and in particular, the p53-MDM2-USP7 pathway is well understood. USP7 is emerging as a promising target for cancer therapy. However, there are limited reports on USP7 inhibitors. Here we report design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel quinazolin-4(3H)-one derivatives as potent USP7 inhibitors. Our results indicated that the compounds C9 and C19 exhibited the greatest potency against the USP7 catalytic domain, with IC(50) values of 4.86 muM and 1.537 muM, respectively. Ub-AMC assays further confirmed IC(50) values of 5.048 muM for C9 and 0.595 muM for C19. MTT assays indicated that gastric cancer MGC-803 cells were more sensitive to these compounds than BGC-823 cells. Flow cytometry analysis revealed that C9 restricted cancer cell growth at the G0/G1 and S phases and inhibited the proliferation and clone formation of MGC-803 cells. Further biochemical experiments indicated that C9 decreased the MDM2 protein level and increased the levels of the tumour suppressors p53 and p21 in a dose-dependent manner. Docking studies predicted that solvent exposure of the side chains of C9 and C19 would uniquely form hydrogen bonds with Met407 of USP7. Additionally, C9 exhibited a remarkable anticancer effect in a zebrafish gastric cancer MGC-803 cell model. Our results demonstrated that quinazolin-4(3H)-one derivatives were suitable as leads for the development of novel USP7 inhibitors and especially for anti-gastric cancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 近期研究表明，去泛素化酶USP7的异常表达通过多种细胞途径诱导肿瘤发生，尤其是p53-MDM2-USP7通路已被充分理解。USP7正成为癌症治疗的一个有前景的靶点。然而，关于USP7抑制剂的研究报道有限。在此，我们报告了新型喹唑啉-4(3H)-酮衍生物作为强效USP7抑制剂的设计、合成及生物学评价。我们的结果表明，化合物C9和C19对USP7催化结构域表现出最强的抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为4.86 μM和1.537 μM。Ub-AMC实验进一步确认了C9的IC(50)值为5.048 μM，C19的为0.595 μM。MTT实验表明，胃癌MGC-803细胞对这些化合物比BGC-823细胞更敏感。流式细胞术分析显示，C9在G0/G1和S期限制癌细胞生长，并抑制MGC-803细胞的增殖和克隆形成。进一步的生化实验表明，C9以剂量依赖性方式降低MDM2蛋白水平，并增加肿瘤抑制因子p53和p21的水平。对接研究预测，C9和C19侧链的溶剂暴露将独特地与USP7的Met407形成氢键。此外，C9在斑马鱼胃癌MGC-803细胞模型中表现出显著的抗癌效果。我们的结果表明，喹唑啉-4(3H)-酮衍生物适合作为开发新型USP7抑制剂，特别是抗胃癌药物的先导化合物。
